name: Teen Leadership Council (High Museum of Art)
what_you_do: Join 15 high school students who learn about art and how a museum works, talk with artists, tour the collection, help with public programs and plan events for other teens.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors and seniors enrolled full time in high school for the program year. The group has 15 members.
pay_detail: Described as a paid position; the amount is not stated on the page.
duration: One-year commitment, including a 6-week summer intensive (June 3 to July 17 in 2026), Wednesday to Friday 9:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., plus regular meetings
deadline_text: 2026-27 cycle: applications opened Feb 1 and closed at midnight March 1 (2026); applicants were told by May 1, 2026. The page does not post the 2027-28 cycle.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application during the Feb 1 to Mar 1 window. Questions: HMATeenPrograms@high.org.
notes: No absences are allowed during the summer intensive. The High's Teens and College page also lists an Early College Program in Art History and Curatorial Studies with the Atlanta University Center for rising juniors and seniors, but it gave no dates or application details.
